name: "Chicken Parmesan" Meatballs & Arugula with Lemon-Shallot Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide parsley between two large bowls.
Finely grate Parmesan. Divide between the two bowls.
Coarsely grate mozzarella. Add all of the mozzarella to one of the bowls, stir to combine, and set aside.

Add chicken, bread crumbs, eggs, oil, and spices to the remaining bowl with the parsley and Parmesan; use your hands to combine the chicken mixture. Using a tablespoon measure, form the mixture into rounded meatballs and place on a large plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg ground chicken
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
3 eggs
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, place tomato sauce and spices in a large baking dish. Stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs and cook, turning often, until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer to the baking dish with the sauce and turn to coat.

Top the saucy meatballs with reserved parsley and two-cheese mixture. Place baking dish in the oven and bake until cheese is melted and meatballs are cooked through, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemons into the reserved bowl.
Peel and mince shallots. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide meatballs, sauce, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
